title: Skoda division theorem on compact Kähler manifolds for line bundles with singular hermitian metrics
summary: We prove a Skoda division theorem on a compact Kähler manifold for holomorphic sections of line bundles with singular hermitian metrics. As a corollary, we prove a Siu-type division theorem on compact Kähler manifolds for holomorphic line bundles endowed with singular hermitian metrics.
